- Data protection: We support GDPR controls and have engineering controls for data residency; for HIPAA we can execute a BAA and our security posture meets the baseline controls required for PHI hosting.
- Questionnaire: You mentioned an internal vendor security questionnaire. Please find our ask below and we are ready to start filling it out once you send it.

Next steps: 
1) Sophie to share EnterpriseCorp vendor questionnaire (we can start with a spreadsheet export)
2) Redwood to return initial responses within 2 business days and surface any controls we need to clarify (owner: Rishi)
3) Schedule a 30-minute doc review to walk through responses and any evidence — suggested times below

Suggested times for review: 2027-04-14 10:00-10:30am ET or 2027-04-15 2:00-2:30pm ET. Let me know what works and I will send a calendar invite.

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that timeline is helpful. Attaching our vendor security questionnaire as an XLSX (EnterpriseCorp_Vendor_Q_2027.xlsx). A few notes from our security team: 

- We will need to confirm whether Redwood will be willing to sign a BAA; PHI handling will require a BAA in our procurement process.
- A handful of GDPR-specific items around data portability and subprocessors may need explicit confirmation.
- We also capture supporting artifacts (certs/reports) in our vendor portal; a SOC 2 report or interim evidence will speed approvals.

We are aiming to finish vendor due diligence by end of May. Can your team commit to returning the completed questionnaire by 2027-04-14? If not, please propose an alternative.

Marissa,

Quick responses:

- SOC 2: We are currently in the Type II testing window. Expected report release is 2027-09-15. We can provide interim evidence (control matrices, SOC2-pss-checklist, penetration test summary) as part of the vendor response.
- BAA / HIPAA: We do support signing a BAA. Legal has a standard BAA template, no unusual conditions anticipated; I will route to Legal for signature once Enterprise sends their procurement contact.
- GDPR / Data residency: We support EU data processing via partner regions and subprocessors are documented. I will surface the subprocessors list and the current DPIA summary.

I can start filling out the XLSX now and aim to return a first pass by EOD 2027-04-12 for Marissa to review, and a finalized package by 2027-04-14. Attaching a working draft SOC2-response-draft.xlsx that has answers to high-level items.

-Rishi
